sections.what: Reads the language cookie and returns it if it is supported, otherwise English.

summary: Finds the reader's chosen language on the server, from a cookie, and falls back to English.
purpose: Lets server-rendered pages show text in the reader's language.
why: The header says the language is set by onboarding and the navigation toggle, and carried in a cookie so the server can read it.
how: 1) Reads the language cookie. 2) If the value is a supported language, uses it. 3) Otherwise uses English. It also re-exports the translation helpers so pages import them from one place.
inputs: The language cookie sent with the request.
outputs: A supported language code, English by default.
risks: Unknown or missing values fall back to English without any message, so a broken cookie is hard to spot.
debug: If a page shows the wrong language, check the cookie value and whether it is one of the supported codes. Check the onboarding and toggle sets it.
